# The `misclassCRC` R Package

## Installation

To install the development version from GitHub, you can use the `pak`
package.

``` r

# install.packages("pak") # uncomment if needed
pak::pkg_install("OJALAB/misclassCRC")
```

## Funding

Work on this package is supported by the OPUS 27 grant no.
2024/53/B/HS4/01580, funded by the National Science Centre in Poland.

## Use of AI Tools

Some elements of the package were designed with the support of OpenAI
Codex, Claude Code, and StatsClaw.

## References

Struzik, A. (2026). [Estimation of job vacancy statistics under
misclassification and missing data using
capture-recapture](https://github.com/OJALAB/misclassCRC/blob/main/references/Struzik-RSS-2026.pdf).
Royal Statistical Society 2026 International Conference, Bournemouth,
United Kingdom.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`crc_fit()`](https://ojalab.ue.poznan.pl/misclassCRC/reference/crc_fit.md)
  : Fit a Capture-Recapture Model
- [`predict(`*`<crc_fit>`*`)`](https://ojalab.ue.poznan.pl/misclassCRC/reference/predict.crc_fit.md)
  : Predict Population Size and Outcome Total
- [`print(`*`<crc_fit>`*`)`](https://ojalab.ue.poznan.pl/misclassCRC/reference/print.crc_fit.md)
  : Print a Capture-Recapture Model Fit
- [`print(`*`<crc_pred>`*`)`](https://ojalab.ue.poznan.pl/misclassCRC/reference/print.crc_pred.md)
  : Print Capture-Recapture Predictions
- [`print(`*`<summary.crc_fit>`*`)`](https://ojalab.ue.poznan.pl/misclassCRC/reference/print.summary.crc_fit.md)
  : Print a Comprehensive Summary of a Capture-Recapture Model Fit
- [`print(`*`<summary.crc_pred>`*`)`](https://ojalab.ue.poznan.pl/misclassCRC/reference/print.summary.crc_pred.md)
  : Print a Summary of Capture-Recapture Predictions
- [`summary(`*`<crc_fit>`*`)`](https://ojalab.ue.poznan.pl/misclassCRC/reference/summary.crc_fit.md)
  : Summarize a Capture-Recapture Model Fit
- [`summary(`*`<crc_pred>`*`)`](https://ojalab.ue.poznan.pl/misclassCRC/reference/summary.crc_pred.md)
  : Summarize Capture-Recapture Predictions
